Learned counsel for the petitioners files a memo seeking permission to withdraw the petition.

2. The memo reads as follows:
"MEMO FOR WITHDRAWAL The Petitioners in the above case may be permitted to withdraw the above petition with liberty to approach the Hon'ble Trial Court to seek an order of discharge, NC: 2024:KHC:41109 since now the charge sheet has been submitted against the petitioners before the Hon'ble Trial Court."
In terms of the memo, the criminal petition is disposed as withdrawn.
I.A.No.1/2022 is also disposed, as a consequence.
